messages.author: b40d9a0724dacefc
messages.subject: gl.report.heterozygosity() odd issue
parts:
Hello,
I am using dartR 2.9.7.  I just wanted to mention and odd problem where I can't use this command if I have the package dartR.base loaded. If I unload that package, I can run gl.report.heterozygosity() without issue.  The example of my command in case you care (I have my own plot_theme and colors loaded:

gl.report.heterozygosity(
  gl,
  method = "pop",
  n.invariant = 0,
  plot.out = TRUE,
  plot_theme = plot_theme,
  plot_colors_pop = color9,
  plot_colors_ind = two_colors,
  save2tmp = FALSE,
  verbose = NULL
)


Thank you for your excellent software program.  I use it A LOT!

Best,
